title: Study
purpose: Read one study: its approval and consent basis, the collections it governs, its consent form versions and how many consents it has by status.

items.label: Code, Title, Status
items.description: As recorded; a status other than Active is also shown as a notice at the top: the study's material cannot be allocated, picked, packed or dispatched.

items.label: Consent basis
items.description: Consent records, or Study-level determination with its reference.

items.label: Recorded
items.description: Who created the study and when.

items.label: Description
items.description: Opens with Description when there is one.

sections.title: Collections governed
paragraphs: Current links first, then ended ones, each with when and by whom it was linked or ended and the reason. Linking makes the collection's specimens, including those already stored, governed by this study. Ending a link is refused while specimens of the collection are allocated or picked for a request; ended links stay listed.

items.label: Link collection
items.description: Admin and manager. Offers active collections that no study governs now.

items.label: End link
items.description: Admin and manager, on a current link. Asks for a reason.

sections.title: Consent forms
paragraphs: Each form version with its kind, the categories it asks and whether it is active. The code opens the form's edit page for admin and manager; Add consent form opens the consent form catalogue form with the study chosen.

sections.title: Consents
paragraphs: Counts of consent records by status; a status with consents opens the consent list filtered to this study and status.

sections.title: History
paragraphs: The newest 50 audit events of the study (edits, links, ends), oldest first, with who, when and the reason.

sections.title: Actions and access
paragraphs: Every staff role (admin, manager, technician, viewer) can open this page. Only admin and manager see and can use the buttons that change records; the server refuses the change to anyone else.
Edit (admin and manager) opens the study form.
